questions.question: 04/01 lost 285k updates. The missing piece?
questions.explanation: The triple must be indivisible; locks fence it.

questions.question: fetch_add(&next,1) guarantees?
options: Unique tickets: read-and-bump as one hardware step
questions.explanation: Atomicity at issue: no two threads draw alike.

questions.question: Spin loop must use atomic_load because?
options: Plain cached read could never see the update (spin forever)
questions.explanation: Reread from coherence every lap or miss the handoff.

questions.question: Unlock = serving++. Wakes whom?
options: Exactly the holder of the next ticket (no herd)
questions.explanation: One writer, one match — thundering herd avoided by numbering.

questions.question: Spin vs sleep rule?
options: Short+contended sections: spin; long/idle waits: sleep (futex)
questions.explanation: Burn cores briefly vs surrender them long — cost model decides.

questions.question: Ticket vs test-and-set fairness?
questions.explanation: Numbering orders admission; raw flags don't.
